title: Bayer letters with Third Reich generals about camp trials
summary: Brigham Buhler tells of Bayer letters with Third Reich generals about camp trials, about World War II at Nazi Germany, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: There's even uh letters back and forth between Bayer and some of the generals of the Third Reich.

plain: A guest named Brigham Buhler, talking on Jesse Michels's podcast about the dark past of the drug industry, says there are letters exchanged between Bayer, a large German drug company, and generals of Nazi Germany during World War II. According to Buhler, these letters concerned medical trials carried out in the camps. If true, it would tie a major company directly to wartime human experiments.
